subject: Demo debrief + proposed POC evaluation plan for ArgoGrid
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@argogrid.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@argogrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2025 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Demo debrief + proposed POC evaluation plan for ArgoGrid

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap + proposal for a focused POC so we can validate Redwood against the three priorities you mentioned: low-latency inference for search assistants, predictable token-costs for high-volume ingestion, and enterprise controls (VPC + KMS).

Summary of what we demoed:
- Real-time assistant demo (avg p95 latency ~120ms on our dedicated profile)
- Cost profiles: batching + KV cache reduced per-token cost in sample workload by ~40%
- RBAC, KMS integration, and audit logs (console preview)

Proposed 4-week POC (goal: verify latency, cost, and security fit):
1) Success criteria (measurable)
   - Latency: p95 inference latency < 200ms for 98% of requests on representative query set (50k daily)
   - Cost: per-invocation token cost <= $0.0025 (measured across full ingestion pipeline)
   - Security: full SOC2 evidence bundle + KMS key rotation test completed in POC environment
2) Scope
   - Ingest sample dataset (10M tokens) via streaming pipeline
   - 2 model routes: low-latency assistant + batch embedding job for nightly indexing
   - Observability: dashboard access and token-level cost breakdowns
3) Timeline (proposed)
   - Week 0 (kickoff): environment access, network prep, sample data handoff
   - Week 1: baseline measurements (current infra) and model route config
   - Week 2: run synthetic load + KV cache tuning
   - Week 3: production-like run and cost analysis
   - Week 4: final report, learnings, and recommended next steps
4) Owners
   - Redwood SE: Marissa Cole (technical lead)
   - Redwood AE: Ben Carter (program manager / commercial lead)
   - ArgoGrid: Alex Morgan (Eng sponsor), Priya Desai (Procurement / Security)

Immediate asks from your side:
- Confirm scope and success criteria above (or call out changes)
- Provide contact for procurement/legal (we can include costs in a follow-up doc)
- Share a small sample dataset (S3 link or similar) for Week 1 baseline

Attachments: ArgoGrid-POC-outline.pdf (detailed plan), redwood-cost-estimate-argogrid.xlsx (ballpark costs).

If that looks OK I can book a 30-minute kickoff next Tue or Wed and loop in our infra engineer for the network checklist.

Thanks,

— Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks Soojin — great demo and appreciate the clear plan. A few clarifying items from our side: 

1) Security / compliance: Priya will want to see SOC 2 Type II and a high-level data flow diagram before we spin up anything in our VPC. Can you include the SOC 2 attestation and the KMS integration notes in the kickoff packet?

2) Cost: the spreadsheet looks reasonable but procurement will want a capped not-to-exceed estimate for the POC. Can Ben provide a short summary with a POC cap?

3) Stakeholders: please include our procurement lead (legal@argogrid.com) on the loop.

Also we prefer kickoff the week of Dec 15 if possible — team bandwidth this week is tight.
